description:
Open Kalshi contracts right now, each with Sardine's historical count. No prices.

        Optionally filter to one market. Each row has the contract, the minutes
        left, the historical settlement rate with its interval and sample size,
        and a one-sentence summary of the count. Kalshi's prices are deliberately
        NOT included (pending Kalshi's Redistribution licence): read them from
        Kalshi's own API, then pass kalshi_ask to get_settlement_rate for the
        fee and the gap.
name: get_live_board
